sources.title: [PATCH 05/17] media: v4l2-mem2mem: support running multiple jobs in parallel

claims.claim: Add support for running multiple jobs in parallel for SoCs containing multiple identical devices. An example is the Rockchip RK3588 SoC, which contains two identical RGA3 devices. Therefore it is desirable to have the kernel schedule the work across all available devices and only expose one video device to the userspace.
